name: Prismz
summary:
Match and then pop cube clusters in this colorful and addictive puzzle game. Little is known about Prismz aside from the cover. The game was available on the now defunct DirecTV Game Lounge channel and is now lost media.

In 2007, the satellite provider DirecTV launched a special paid channel in cooperation with GSN on their service known as the Game Lounge. This interactive channel provided a variety of games on a rotating schedule that could be played with the DirecTV remote. On March 6, 2013, the Game Lounge service was officially discontinued by DirecTV, leaving most games on the service completely lost.
